text: It's been 7 years, my loves. 7 years of loving you unconditionally, of you being my everything. You taught me everything because this is who you are. You're the purest souls this earth has ever seen, the most selfless and loving persons alive. And I couldn't be more grateful for you. I dedicate this song to SEVENTEEN, especially Kim Mingyu! 

05/26/2022
Happy 7th anniversary, SEVENTEEN! Cheers for a longer time! It's my first time celebrating your anniversary. Its been 8 months since I became a CARAT. It's a wonderful and lucky family. I've experienced many "firsts" as a CARAT. 

Do you know what I regret the most? I didn't love SEVENTEEN from the beginning. I'm tearing up thinking, "How nice it would be to be with you from the beginning." Thank you so much for coming in to my life. You gave me a reason to live and be happy again. The best thing that happened to me last 2021 was meeting you all! Loving SEVENTEEN is one of the best decision I've made in my life. First of all, Mingyuya, thank you very much. You are one of the best man I know. I want to hug SEVENTEEN members. I have mixed feelings right now. Mingyu, my love, thank you for encouraging the members to stay together. Wow, I can't stop crying, help me! My Darling SEVENTEEN, always remember that CARATs are always here for you through ups and downs. You all are the best boys! Let's rock the world with SEVENTEEN's 4th full album! Fighting! You all are doing great, always! I'm so proud of SEVENTEEN, the best Darlings! Let's be each other's strength. Don't be hard on yourself! We will protect SEVENTEEN at all cost! Sometimes, I don't understand you, but I love you! I'm always rooting for you from afar. I hope it will always reach you! Let's be together forever! I love you, Mahal ko kayo! 😭❤️

author: @Minghaoi
text:
My new Carat-self didn’t know the thanks mv was depicting Seventeen in their pre-debut days to their journey to debuting & if you knew their past, God is it heartbreaking.

0:17 Joshua & Jeonghan’s “You quit, I quit.”
0:23 Them planning their own choreography because they didn’t have a choice
0:36 A room reminiscent to the melona prison where they stayed up late just to practice.
0:39 The studio which Seventeen self-produced their own songs with the help of Bumzu. The HHU writing their own lyrics.
0:57 the vocal classes
1:18 the lights flashing on & off portraying the poor conditions of the old building yet they continue to persevere.
2:39 A dressing room packed. The goal so near, yet the dream too far.

All throughout the mv, every scene was dimly lit because they never knew what the future holds for them or how far they could go as artists like every other new kpop groups in the over saturated industry. The path was dark but they had each other. They worked so hard, sacrificed their childhood & time, how could they ever fail? I’m glad the place they are in now, the people they work with, & the company had improved greatly. They know what they want and what to do, we don’t have to worry so much about them anymore.

Happy 4 years, 고맙다! We won't change because we're engraved in each other's hearts
